**Formula used:**

**Calculation:**

Delhi = 50 + 20 + 50 + 20 + 70 = 210

Mumbai = 170 + 15 + 25 + 30 + 60 = 300

Kolkata = 195 + 17 + 70 + 50 + 80 = 412

Chennai = 200 + 13 + 30 + 60 + 90 = 393

⇒ The centre with the least number of candidates is Delhi with 210 candidates.
